subject: Cross-functional sync: closure log for QBR asks, roadmap exceptions
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-functional sync — action log + asks for QBR

Team,

Thanks for a productive weekly sync this morning. I promised a short follow-up with the concrete closure log and ownership so we can be QBR-ready by the 7/20 exec review. Please treat this as the authoritative action list for the roadmap exceptions and the three exec asks that came up.

Summary of asks (from today's meeting):
- Exec ask A: Provide a concise impact quant (latency/cost) for the proposed model quant profile. Owner: Marcus. Due: 7/13.
- Exec ask B: Decide on exception gating for Dedicated customers (SLA/rollout plan). Owner: Lauren + Legal touchpoint. Due: 7/15.
- QBR presentation: Integrate the exception registry + proposed mitigations into the QBR deck. Owner: Marissa. Due: 7/17.

Roadmap exceptions noted during the sync (high level):
- Workload X: requires higher CPU headroom for <512-token bursts — temporary bypass planned.
- Model Y: pending quant baseline validation (see action A).

Immediate asks from me:
1) Marcus — attach a two-slide appendix with the cost/latency delta for the quant profiles (best case / expected / worst case). Call out token-cost delta and 95th pct latency.
2) Lauren — confirm who will own the gating policy doc and add Legal review owner.
3) Grace — can you confirm whether Support needs a notification template for customers affected by the exception?

Attachments: I've attached the latest QBR strawman (v2) and the tracker spreadsheet.

If anything is missing or mis-assigned, reply-all with the correction. I will send a consolidated closure note by EOD next Tuesday (7/13).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: QBR_strawman_v2.pdf] [Attachment: roadmap-exceptions-tracker.xlsx]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-functional sync — action log + asks for QBR

Thanks Marissa — noted. Quick clarifications:

- For the gating policy doc, I'll own the first draft. I'll add Legal (cc'd in my internal tracker) and ask Legal to respond within 5 business days. Target for the gating doc draft: 7/12.
- For Dedicated customers: if we anticipate an SLA exception, we should prepare a fallback communications plan for at-risk customers (Acme and Globex flagged). Can Sales ops pull a list of impacted Dedicated customers?

On the Support notification: Grace, if you confirm the template, we can ship a short version to affected customers and a more detailed FAQ on the Support portal.

I'll also highlight the exception gating as an 'ask' in the QBR appendix so execs can sign off on the proposed thresholds.

Lauren
VP, Revenue Operations

[Inline: adding Lauren's quick notes to the tracker]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-functional sync — action log + asks for QBR

Agree with the plan. Two priority clarifications from the exec side:
1) The exec committee wants a single slide that shows the projected business impact if we do NOT resolve the Model Y quant variance by next quarter. Please quantify risk to gross margin and potential lost deals (work with Sales for deal-level impact).
2) If the gating policy imposes extra friction on Dedicated onboarding, we need a temporary credit policy to protect pipeline. Ask Finance for a pre-approved range (I can escalate).

Marcus: please prioritize the cost/latency second slide Aditya asked for — call out sensitivity to token distribution. This will help me argue for budget in the QBR.

Aditya
Head of Product Strategy

[Quoted below is the original message for context]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, lauren.bishop@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: grace.oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700

All — acknowledging owners and scope. Quick technical notes and constraints so expectations are aligned:

- Quant profile evaluation: I will run the baseline comparison (FP16 vs 4-bit/q4) on the representative Model Y workload and capture median/95th pct latency and token-cost delta. Expect the initial numbers by EOD 7/12; finalized slides by 7/13.
- Workload X CPU headroom: infra suggests a 10% headroom bump can be deployed as a short-term exception; longer-term solution requires scheduler changes (Q3 effort). I'll note the proposed temporary bypass in the exceptions tracker.
- Caveat: some of the worst-case latency numbers depend heavily on sequence-length skew — I'll include assumptions in the appendix.

I attached a short security evidence summary that Support and Sales can reference if customers ask about data handling during the exception window.

Marcus
Sr. Director, Serving Runtime

[Attachment: security-evidence-summary.pdf]

Appreciate the quick confirmations. Final closure log update (for tracking):

Closed / Owned:
- Gating doc owner confirmed: Lauren — draft due 7/12.
- Support template: Grace to provide one-liner + FAQ draft by 7/14.

In progress:
- Quant impact slides: Marcus — initial numbers 7/12; slides + appendix 7/13. (Aditya asked for an additional slide mapping to gross margin; Marcus please coordinate with Sales ops.)
- QBR deck: Marissa — integrate appendix and exceptions slide by 7/17.

Blockers / Risks:
- If Model Y quant validation shows >12% cost delta, we may need an alternate mitigation plan — Marcus, please flag early if numbers trend that direction.
- Dedicated onboarding friction — Lauren to confirm credit policy ask with Finance this week.

Next steps: I'll update the shared Drive folde r(QBR-Prep-Shared) with the latest deck and send the final exec packet on 7/17 morning. If anyone's scope shifts, reply-all with the change and new owner.

Thanks — closing this out for today.

Marissa
